communication-reach.flag: clause 13.16.36 is reached by the 2002 communication section (Annex A, the CD entry)
communication-reach.answer: A CD record can hold a format 2 OCCURS (probe cdodo.cob at 2002: accepted, LENGTH 5 with N=3), but GR9 applies only when 'the associated file description or sort-merge description entry contains the VARYING phrase of the RECORD clause' (§2002:13.16.36.3 GR9); a CD entry has no RECORD clause, so the rule never applies to a CD record. Scope unchanged.
